description:
Achievements - Renewed

WHAT DOES THIS MOD DO?
Achievements for the campaign, kept across all your saves.
Each one starts greyed out with a hint. Once you get it, it shows what it was and what it unlocked.
The base game has its own tab, and so has every mod that adds achievements.
Other mods can add their own achievements and chains with one CSV file.
Needs LunaLib.

Screenshots

How it works

Open the list with the hotkey (K, set in LunaLib), or put the Achievements ability on your ability bar.
Reset achievements, at the bottom of the list, sets every achievement back to not done after you confirm.
The first tab, Achievements, holds the base game's achievements. Every mod with achievements has a tab of its own, in alphabetical order.
An achievement you do not have shows its name and a hint. Secret ones show nothing until done. The LunaLib setting "Show how to get achievements" shows the exact condition instead, secret ones included.
Under each achievement: what it unlocks or pays in other mods (Rule Book rules, New Game Plus career points).
Counted achievements show your progress in the current save, for example "3 / 10".
Chains come in steps. A later step shows up when the one before it is done.
Getting one shows a message on the campaign screen and adds an entry to the intel log, with a button that shows it in the list. A LunaLib setting turns the message off.
Done achievements count for every save.

Base game achievements

The list (spoilers)
Rank (chain): reach level 5, then 10, then 15.
Explorer (chain): visit 25%, then 50%, then 100% of the Sector's star systems in one campaign.
Battle record (chain): win 10, then 50, then 200 battles in one campaign.
Win 10 battles against Remnant fleets in one campaign.
Have a capital ship in your fleet.
One secret achievement.
Story: finish The Kallichore Archive, Finding Coureuse, Project Ziggurat, At The Gates, Abyssal Space Oddity, The Usurpers, Princess of Persea, Pilgrim's Path, Knight Errant, False Idols, The Stray Flock and Passage To Volturn. Defeat the Ziggurat, return the ISS Hamatsu, win the duel on Eventide, recover the planetkiller, earn Kanta's protection.
Colonies (chain): found a colony, grow one to size 6, own five.
Hold a million credits.
Win a battle. Beat a fleet twice your size. Defeat an orbital station, a Remnant fleet, a Shrouded Dweller fleet, an Omega fleet and a Threat fleet.

Achievements for other mods

Many mods get achievements here even though they add none themselves, each in that mod's tab and only while that mod is on.
Quests, story missions and named bounties of 38 mods, for example Nexerelin, Secrets of the Frontier, Sephira Conclave, Crab Shack, Domain Phase Lab, Emergent Threats, Halo Dynamics, Lost.Sector, Knights of Ludd and United Aurora Federation.
Oddisz's mods too: Sol Renewed, Gambling Den, Cloning, Reverse Engineered Private Arsenal, Colonial Hypergrowth, Omega Core Everywhere, The Everything Shop and New Game Plus - Renewed.

Works with

Rule Book - Renewed: some achievements unlock its rules, and say which once done. Its challenges have a tab of their own.
New Game Plus - Renewed: its feats are achievements here, and every achievement pays career points there, once per profile.
MagicLib: the achievements of MagicLib mods (Nexerelin and others) are listed read-only among the others of that mod's tab.
Quality Perks, Quality Captains: their milestones are listed read-only in their own tab.

For modders

Add achievements with data/config/achievements_renewed/achievements.csv in your mod: name, hint, how-to line, icon, category, goal, secret, reward text, chain and step.
Your achievements get a tab with your mod's name. The tab column puts a row in any other tab instead.
Check them without Java: memory flags (several at once, a value, or not set), a person's, faction's or station's memory, a skill, the player's level, colonies, credits, battles won against a faction, or an industry on a colony with a given AI core and item. Or name a Java class.
Java API: isDone, progress, complete, addProgress, a listener for new achievements, a line under achievements for what your mod gives, and a call that opens the list.
Sector memory holds $acr_doneCount and $acr_totalCount for rules.csv.
The README on GitHub has the columns and examples.

Credits

MagicLib by Wispborne and the modding community, Quality Perks and Quality Captains by Dal: only read, nothing of theirs is included.

AI use disclaimer
Some or all assets and code in this mod were created using AI tools:
Code: Claude Code (Claude Fable 5.2, Claude Opus 5.5)
Text (achievement texts, readme and this post): Claude Code (Claude Fable 5.2, Claude Opus 5.5)
Icons: drawn by scripts written by Claude Code (Claude Fable 5.2, Claude Opus 5.5)

License
This mod is under the CC0 1.0 (Creative Commons Zero) License, allowing you to do whatever you want with it, without giving any credit to anyone. The LICENSE file is in the download and on GitHub.

Version log
1.0.1
Colonial Hypergrowth's achievements are in a tab named Colonial Hypergrowth.

1.0.0
Version 1.0.0: the mod is now considered stable. No gameplay changes.

0.8.0
Updated for Starsector 0.98.5a.

0.7.1
The Achievements ability no longer puts itself on the ability bar in a new game. Pick it from the ability list if you want it there.

0.7.0
A Reset achievements button at the bottom of the list sets every achievement back to not done, for all saves, after you confirm. MagicLib achievements are not reset.

0.6.0
9 achievements for the quests of Navarchy of Tania: the classified missions Whiskey, Foxtrot and Charlie, The Lurking Death and the Vela beacon.

0.5.2
Every word of every achievement name starts with a capital letter.

0.5.1
Every achievement has a new name, and many have a new hint.
Removed: Destroy a shrouded ship (Sol Renewed), Start with a Starter Pack (StarterPack) and Sign a contract (Missions - Renewed).

0.5.0
The list opens from the new Achievements button on the ability bar, or with a hotkey (K, set in LunaLib). The Achievements entry on the intel screen is gone.
The intel entry of a new achievement has a Show it in the list button that opens its tab, scrolled to it and marked.
Every achievement shows its name, with the hint under it until it is done. Secret ones read Secret Achievement instead of ???. A chain step not reached yet reads Next step.
MagicLib achievements sit among the others in their mod's tab, without a MagicLib heading.
What an achievement pays or unlocks in other mods shows under it, done or not: Rule Book rules, and New Game Plus career points once New Game Plus supports it.
Chains have more space around them and padding below the last step.
Achievements that can be done in any order are no longer chains: the colony ones, the Reverse Engineered Private Arsenal ones, Destroy a shrouded ship (Sol Renewed), and the quests of Nexerelin, Sephira Conclave (Missing Aces, False Flag Operation) and Emergent Threats.
Enter 25 star systems is replaced by a chain: visit 25%, 50% and 100% of the Sector's star systems in one campaign. Hidden systems do not count.
Defeat an Omega, Threat or Dweller fleet is now three achievements: Defeat a Shrouded Dweller fleet (it keeps the Rule Book unlock), Defeat an Omega fleet and Defeat a Threat fleet.
For modders: Achievements.addRewardText adds a line under achievements (what your mod gives for them), and Achievements.openList(ui, id) opens the list at one achievement.

0.4.0
157 achievements for the quests, story missions and named bounties of 37 other mods, such as Nexerelin, Secrets of the Frontier, Sephira Conclave, Crab Shack, Domain Phase Lab and Emergent Threats. Each sits in the tab of its mod and shows only while that mod is on.
The New Game Plus - Renewed feats about other mods are among them, with the same names, so they also show without New Game Plus and count once.
For modders: the memory, player_memory and persistent checks take several keys ($a&$b, $a|$b), a value ($key=VALUE, $key>=10) and !$key for not set. New checks person_memory:id:$key, faction_memory:id:$key, entity_memory:id:$key and skill:id.

0.3.2
Finish At The Gates, Grow a colony to size 6 and Defeat an Omega, Threat or Dweller fleet show the icon of the Rule Book rule they unlock.

0.3.1
Visit the Great Mall is now Visit the Gate of Babylon, for The Everything Shop (the older Extra Submarkets still counts). It sits in The Everything Shop's tab.
The two Chicken's Tech Shop achievements are gone.

0.3.0
45 more achievements, taken over from Rule Book - Renewed with the same names and conditions: 26 for the base game (story missions, colonies, a million credits, battles) and 19 for other mods, each in the tab of its mod. Achievements you already have stay done.
Their reward lines, such as "Unlocks the rule Ludd's Song", show only while Rule Book - Renewed is on.
For modders: new column rewardMod. The reward text shows only while that mod is on (same form as requiredMod).

0.2.2
The mod now has its forum topic. Mod managers link to it.

0.2.1
New gold icon in mod managers (TriOS) and in LunaLib's settings.

0.2.0
The list has a column of tabs. The first tab, Achievements, holds base game achievements only. Every mod with achievements has its own tab, in alphabetical order, with its done and total count.
The Other mods tab is gone. MagicLib achievements and the Quality Perks milestones sit in the tab of the mod they come from.
For modders: new tab column (empty: a tab named after your mod, any text: that tab, vanilla: the first tab) and Builder.tab. requiredMod takes & between groups: a|b&c|d means (a or b) and (c or d).
For modders: new built-in check industry:<id>, with optional AI core and special item: industry:<id>:<core>:<item>.
When one check completes more than three achievements, three messages show and one line counts the rest. The file in saves/common is written once for all of them.
Fixed: a built-in check with a dot in its key, such as memory:$my.key, was taken for a class name and the row was left out.
The intel entry lists the counts per tab. An achievement's intel entry names its tab.
Licence: CC0 1.0, in a LICENSE file.

0.1.0
First public release.
Achievements entry on the intel screen, with a button that opens the list.
Every achievement starts greyed out with a hint. Once done it shows its name, what it was for and what it gave. A LunaLib setting shows the exact conditions instead of the hints.
Achievements are kept across all saves. Counted ones show their progress in the current save.
Chains: steps that show up one after another.
A campaign message and an intel log entry when an achievement is done. A LunaLib setting turns the message off.
10 achievements for the base game.
Other mods can add achievements with a CSV file and a small Java API.
With MagicLib installed, the Other mods tab lists the achievements of MagicLib mods such as Nexerelin. It also lists the milestones of Quality Perks and Quality Captains.

aiDescription: Provides a unified interface for viewing achievements from the base game and supported mods, organized into alphabetical tabs. Achievements are saved globally, allowing players to track long-term goals like story completions or fleet milestones. Modders can easily add custom achievements using a single CSV file without needing Java code.
